messages:
alex: Heads-up — customer reported surprising cost spikes when their embedding payloads vary in dims. They can't see how many 'embed units' requests cost, so they overpack batches and hit soft-quotas. Could we surface an estimate in Console and via preflight headers?

maria: +1. We already compute an estimate in preflight for routing. Expose it in Console Request Details and maybe the route dashboard.

sam: Slight flag — we expose internal cost model. But if it's per-tenant and only an estimate, seems fine. We should label it clearly as "estimated units" and not a bill. :warning:

alex: Agreed on labeling. Proposal: API returns preflight header `X-Embed-Estimate-Units` and a machine-friendly `X-Embed-Estimate-BREAKDOWN` (JSON string) for debugging. Console displays estimate + breakdown for each sampled request and an aggregate histogram.

julian: Breakdown should include contributions: tokens, dims, padding, per-item rounding. Otherwise folks will draw wrong conclusions (eg think dims have no cost).

ingress-bot: FYI we already emit an internal metric `ingress.embed.estimate_units` (counter + histogram) but it's sampled and doesn't ship to customer console.

maria: We need telemetry names and labels spelled out: `ingress.embed.estimate_units` (value), labels: tenant_id, route, model, batch_size, dims_signature. Add p50/p95/p99 and a daily sum. Console can query these to render charts.

sam: Runtime note: computing breakdown per item for large batches is O(n). For the header we can ship the summed units and a compact breakdown at bucket-level (e.g., counts per dims class). Example: {"128":4,"768":1} meaning 4 items 128d + 1 item 768d.

alex: That helps. UI folks want an example header to wire up parsing. ingress-bot — can you paste the current header snippet?

ingress-bot: Sure — current preflight middleware emits: ```http
X-Embed-Estimate-Units: 2048
X-Embed-Estimate-Breakdown: {"tokens":10240,"dims_buckets":"128:8,768:1","pad_overhead":64}
```

julian: Two UX points: 1) show units per request and per-item average, 2) in route dashboard let users filter by dims bucket so they can see which tenant workloads are high-cost.

maria: Backend work: add a Prometheus-friendly metric `ingress_embed_estimate_units_sum` and `ingress_embed_estimate_units_bucket` with dimensions: tenant_id, route, dims_bucket. We'll also add an internal feature flag `console.embed_estimates_v1`.

sam: Rollout: feature flag on by default for internal tenants, opt-in for customers. Watch for confusion channels. Logging should show when we fail to parse breakdown.

alex: Decisions: expose header + breakdown, surface in Console behind flag, emit metric with labels. Owners: Maria (console UI + telemetry wiring), Sam (ingress + metrics), Julian (breakdown UX). Timeline: internal canary next week, beta in 2 weeks.

devex-bot: Quick implementation snippet for ingress (pseudo): ```python
# preflight estimator middleware
def attach_estimate(resp, batch):
    units = sum(estimate_item(it) for it in batch)
    breakdown = bucket_dims(batch)
    resp.headers['X-Embed-Estimate-Units'] = str(units)
    resp.headers['X-Embed-Estimate-BREAKDOWN'] = json.dumps({"units":units,"buckets":breakdown})
    metrics.histogram('ingress.embed.estimate_units', units, labels=get_labels())
```

maria: UI note: console team will add a small tooltip: "Estimated units — internal guidance for batching/quantization. Not a bill." Also add a link to docs with example optimization tips.

alex: Action items: Maria create console PR + example query; Sam expose Prom metrics & header; Julian draft docs snippet explaining dims buckets and common mistakes. I'll coordinate canary and prepare a short customer-facing FAQ.

sam: I'll open the ingress PR today and link to the feature flag.

julian: I'll sketch the tooltip copy and example graphs.

alex: Thanks all. If anyone sees a privacy or KMS concern about sending breakpoints to console, ping security. Otherwise we'll proceed. :thumbsup:
